title: LiteLLM Config Schema
description: Configuration schema for LiteLLM-X-Server-Config management script

models.description: Manual LiteLLM /model/new payloads to append to generated provider and alias models. Use this for router models or other LiteLLM-native model groups that do not belong to a credentialed provider.

model_aliases.description: Model group aliases that expand into LiteLLM model entries. Keys are exposed model group names; values map target LiteLLM model literals to per-target overrides. Use '$extends' to inherit targets from other alias groups. Use '$interface/' prefix in keys and targets to expand across all interfaces (e.g. '$interface/secondary' becomes 'anthropic/secondary', 'openai/secondary').

oneOf.description: Inherit targets from another model_aliases group
Inherit targets from multiple model_aliases groups

$extends.description: Inherit targets from one or more other model_aliases groups. Local targets override inherited ones.

aliases.description: Model name aliases mapping. Keys can be literal alias names or '$models:<service>/<interface>' refs that expand into one alias per model in that provider/interface (raw model name -> prefixed model name).

additionalProperties.description: Target model name, another alias, or empty string (for $models: refs, empty means use the prefixed model name)

fallbacks.description: Fallback rules for automatic routing on failure. Keys and fallback targets can use '$interface/' to expand across all configured interfaces, matching model_aliases behavior.

items.description: Fallback rule mapping source model to fallback targets. Source keys can use '$interface/' (e.g. '$interface/primary') to expand once per configured interface.
Fallback model name, '$interface/<name>' resolved from the source key interface, or '$base' to expand base config fallbacks for this key

additionalProperties.description: List of fallback model names. Use '$base' to reference base config fallbacks.

public_model_hub.description: List of model group names or aliases to expose in LiteLLM public model hub

public_model_hub_autofill_disabled.description: Disable autofilling public_model_hub from derived model defaults

model_name_base_model_map.description: Global mapping of model names to base_model identifiers. Used as fallback when a model does not specify its own base_model.

guardrails.description: LiteLLM guardrails keyed by guardrail_name and managed through the guardrail management API.

router_settings.description: Raw router settings to merge into LiteLLM's /config/update router_settings. Applied after aliases and fallbacks.

guardrail.description: LiteLLM guardrail configuration. guardrail_name is supplied by the parent object key.

manual_model.description: Manual LiteLLM model payload appended directly to generated config output.

model_name.description: LiteLLM model group name to expose.

litellm_params.description: LiteLLM params for this model. Must include the LiteLLM model identifier.

model_info.description: LiteLLM model metadata such as access_groups or base_model.

$extend.description: Inherit configuration from another provider. Set to null to remove inheritance.

api_key.description: API key for authentication (typically in config.local.json)

api_base.description: Base URL for the API endpoint

models_api_base.description: Base URL for the /models listing endpoint (defaults to api_base if not specified)

is_public_model_hub.description: Default public model hub visibility for all models under this provider

models.description: Default models for all interfaces under this provider. Interface-level models override/extend these.

models_autofill_disabled.description: Default for all interfaces under this provider. Set to true to disable auto-fetching models from the provider's API. Interface-level setting overrides this. Autofill is enabled by default.

api_base.description: Base URL override for this interface. Defaults to the provider-level api_base.

models_api_base.description: Base URL override for this interface's /models listing endpoint. Defaults to interface api_base, then provider-level models_api_base, then provider-level api_base.

models_autofill_disabled.description: Set to true to disable auto-fetching models from the provider's API. Autofill is enabled by default.

model_name_prefix.description: Literal prefix for derived model group names on this interface. Defaults to '{interface}/' (e.g. 'openai/', 'anthropic/') when omitted or null. Set to empty string to disable prefixing.

ignored.description: If true, skip exposing this model completely.

oneOf.description: Comma-separated model group names. Leading comma includes the derived model name. Defaults to the key if not specified.
Map of model group names to per-name overrides. Use "$self" for the derived model name.

model_name_prefix.description: Override the derived model name prefix for this model. Takes precedence over interface-level model_name_prefix. Can also be set per entry in the object form of model_names.

access_groups.description: Access groups for this model (overrides provider-level access_groups)

is_public_model_hub.description: Whether this model should be exposed in LiteLLM's public model hub (overrides provider-level default)

base_model.description: Base model identifier for pricing/capabilities lookup
